name: 710 Labs | 1g Persy Badder | 36 Cakez #11
description: Commonly known as cold cure, Persy Badder is a more stable form of our fresh press 90u rosin. After the rosin is pressed, it is sealed into jars and left to cure at room temperature, forming an opaque, badder-like consistency with minimal terpene degradation.
